thread:
Julia (Support): Hey team — customer reports tool-calling structured output failing intermittently. Customer: Acme. Endpoint: POST /v1/chat/completions -> model=redwood-chat-extended. Error in response: "schema validation failed: missing required field 'tools[0].output.items'". Request IDs: r-q7a9c4 and r-q7a9c5 (same hour).

Repro curl we used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-extended","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"List available printers and return as JSON with keys name, ip, status and capabilities (array) and call print_tool with selected printer id"}],"tools": [{"name":"print_tool","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"printer_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["printer_id"]}}],"tool_call":{"name":"print_tool","arguments":{}}}'
```

Customer says the model used to return a top-level tools array with output.items but now sometimes returns `output` as a string fragment or returns an empty object. Need suggestions for repro traces and what logs to pull.

Matt (Eng-ML): Thanks Julia. Can you attach the full raw responses (the body we got from the API) for r-q7a9c4 and r-q7a9c5? Also which runtime variant were they routed to? (g4dn-small vs ded-prod-1)

Julia (Support): attaching snippets inline — note we sanitize tokens. For r-q7a9c4 got: `{"id":"r-q7a9c4","choices":[{"message":{"tool_call":{"name":"print_tool","arguments":"{"printer_id": "p-123"}"}}}]}`. For r-q7a9c5 got: `{"id":"r-q7a9c5","choices":[{"message":{"tool_call":{}}}]}`. No errors in HTTP status (200).

Sara (Eng Runtime): Hmm HTTP 200 but missing expected structured fields — could be model decoding instability or post-processing validator dropping fields. I need the routing header X-Redwood-Node and X-Redwood-Model-Variant from the original requests. Can support paste the original request headers (we just need the two X- headers)?

Ryan (Support): I asked customer to forward their request headers and raw response bodies; they sent them encrypted. I can share the sanitized debug bundle link once they approve. Meanwhile logs-bot, can you pull inference logs for r-q7a9c4 and r-q7a9c5 (last 24h)?

logs-bot: Automated log excerpt: 
```
[2026-02-10T14:02:12Z] r-q7a9c4 assigned -> node ded-prod-1 (variant: v2026-02-opt)
[2026-02-10T14:02:12Z] model output tokens: "...{\"tool_call\":{\"name\":\"print_tool\",\"arguments\":\"{\\\"printer_id\\\":\\\"p-123\\\"}\"}}..."
[2026-02-10T14:02:12Z] postprocessor: attempted parse -> success
[2026-02-10T14:03:01Z] r-q7a9c5 assigned -> node ded-prod-1 (variant: v2026-02-opt)
[2026-02-10T14:03:01Z] model output tokens: "...{\"tool_call\":{}}..."
[2026-02-10T14:03:01Z] postprocessor: attempted parse -> failure (empty arguments)
```

Matt (Eng-ML): The logs show both routed to same variant. The first looks like arguments were serialized as a string (double-encoded JSON). The second may be tokenization cut off or hallucinated empty object. Two parallel hypotheses: a) model produced stringified JSON vs structured JSON intermittently (we should be tolerant in the schema parser), b) KV cache / batching truncation dropped tokens.

Sara (Eng Runtime): Can we reproduce locally by forcing the same variant and prompt plus same max_tokens/stop sequence? Ryan — can you run this adjusted curl that forces streaming=false and includes X-Redwood-Force-Variant header to pin to ded-prod-1? Also include --data-binary to avoid client-side newline munging.

Ryan (Support): Will run and paste results. Test curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'X-Redwood-Force-Variant: v2026-02-opt' \n  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{"model":"redwood-chat-extended","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"List available printers and return as JSON with keys name, ip, status and capabilities (array) and call print_tool with selected printer id"}],"tools":[{"name":"print_tool","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"printer_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["printer_id"]}}],"stream":false}
JSON
```

Ryan (Support): Running now... result: returns structured tool_call with arguments as a JSON string again in 3/5 runs, direct object in 2/5 runs. Attached raw responses.

Matt (Eng-ML): That pattern strongly suggests nondeterministic generation boundary. Two actionable items: 1) make schema parser accept stringified JSON for tool arguments temporarily and 2) collect model token stream for the failing runs (we need token-level output). Sara can you enable debug-token-dump for that variant for a short window?

Sara (Eng Runtime): Will enable debug-token-dump for ded-prod-1 for 30m and add a small patch to postprocessor to log pre-parse raw string. Doing it now — will share logging link.

Julia (Support): I'll ask customer for permission to pull their full raw responses and to run the pinned curl a few times, will attach the debug bundle link here when they approve. Also confirming billing and auth are fine — they can hit the API successfully, no 401s.

Matt (Eng-ML): One more thought — do we have recent changes to the structured-output instruction template? If the model sees slightly different prompt prefixes it may switch serialization style. I'll grep recent prompt-template commits.

Ryan (Support): Customer gave OK to upload sanitized debug bundle: https://internal.redwood/debug-bundles/DBG-20260210-ACME-17 (contains headers, raw bodies, minimal PII removed).

Sara (Eng Runtime): Got the bundle. I see runs where the model emits "arguments": "{...}" with escaping. Token dumps forthcoming.

Matt (Eng-ML): Great. Once token dumps are available I'll correlate token boundaries with the JSON delimiters, then propose a fix in the postprocessor: if arguments is a string that parses as JSON, deserialize it. I'll open a quick PR and flag it for hotfix if we see production impact.

Julia (Support): Thanks everyone — will update Acme that we're investigating and will follow up after token dump analysis. :thumbsup:

logs-bot: Token-dump link for r-q7a9c4 / r-q7a9c5: https://internal.redwood/token-dumps/td-1775123456.zip

Sara (Eng Runtime): Token dump shows truncated closing braces for r-q7a9c5 in some runs — streaming/chunk boundary issue in the runtime serializer. I'll coordinate with infra to patch serializer flush.

Matt (Eng-ML): If runtime patch is needed we should also add tolerant parsing in the postprocessor so customer apps aren't affected during rollout. I'll prepare both PRs.

Julia (Support): Marking this high-priority for Acme. I'll create a follow-up thread for rollout notes once eng has a patch plan.

Ryan (Support): FYI — I also added a note to the customer's ticket with the debug-bundle link and current status.

Sara (Eng Runtime): Will post patch ETA in the next 2 hours.

Julia (Support): Thanks all, closing loop for now — will ping when patch is live. :pray:
